A map showing the Arabian Peninsula and the Horn of Africa. A dotted arrow starts at Makkah, crosses the Red Sea, and lands in the Kingdom of Abyssinia (modern Ethiopia). Beside the map, an inset illustration shows a group of Arabs standing respectfully before a crowned African king seated on a throne, with Ja'far bin Abi Talib gesturing as he recites the Qur'an.

A vibrant illustration of a Trans-Saharan trade caravan arriving at a bustling West African city (like Timbuktu). Men in flowing robes (Arab and Berber merchants) unload goods from heavily laden camels. In the background, a traditional mud-brick mosque with wooden beams protruding from it stands tall.
